page.overview:
Who is Bunsen?

Bunsen is a one-time character who appears in the The Super Mario Bros. Super Show! episode "Robo Koopa." She is a robot from the city of Robo Land and a friend of Dr. Nerdnick.

Bunsen's name originates from , a type of gas burner used as laboratory equipment.
